text: A shopkeeper sells an item at a profit of 20%. If he had bought it at 10% less and sold it for $18 less, he would have gained 30%. What is the cost price of the item?
explanation: Let Cost Price = 100x. Selling Price = 120x. New CP = 90x. New SP = 120x - 18. New profit = 30% of 90x = 27x. So, 120x - 18 = 90x + 27x = 117x => 3x = 18 => x = 6. CP = 100 * 6 = $600.

text: A and B can complete a work in 15 days and 10 days respectively. They started the work together but A left after 3 days. In how many days will B complete the remaining work?
explanation: Rate A = 1/15, Rate B = 1/10. Together = 1/15 + 1/10 = 1/6 per day. In 3 days they complete 3/6 = 1/2 of the work. Remaining = 1/2. B takes (1/2) / (1/10) = 5 days.

A train 150 meters long passes a telegraph post in 12 seconds. How long will it take to cross a bridge of length 250 meters?
explanation: Speed = 150 / 12 = 12.5 m/s. Distance to cross bridge = 150 + 250 = 400m. Time = 400 / 12.5 = 32 seconds.
